purpose: Teach: コック/小鳥/泳ぎ/電球/病室/好き嫌い/真っ直ぐ/昼飯

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、コックさんが、お友達なんだって、すごいわよね、本当に、メイ姉さん、ご紹介、いただいたわよ、本当に、感激したわよ、お料理、最高だった。
lines.en: Sho — your dad being friends with that chef, that's incredible. And he introduced me to them. I was really moved. The food was absolutely perfect.
lines.style: Warmth rising through the words. Animated but genuine — not performing excitement. Soft landing on the compliments, like she's making sure Sho knows she treasures what he gave her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、公園に、小鳥、たくさん、来てるよ、見て、可愛いね、本当に、ぼく、写真、撮りたいよ、メイ姉さん、撮ってくれる?
lines.en: Mei-sis — there are so many little birds in the park right now. Look! They're so cute. I really want to take a picture. Will you take one for me?
lines.style: Quick, eager openings. Eyes bright with the discovery. Slight pleading lilt on the question — not demanding, but hopeful. The rhythm of a child pulling an adult toward something small and wonderful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: プールで、翔くんの、泳ぎ、見たいな、メイ姉さん、本当に、応援したいよ、夏休み、一緒に、行こうね、約束しようね、絶対、楽しみよ、私、本当に。
lines.en: I'd really love to see you swim at the pool, Sho. Mei-sis wants to cheer you on. Let's go together over summer break, okay? Promise me. I'm already looking forward to it so much.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate openness. Each phrase settles before the next. Warmth in the voice — this is tender because it's real, not performed. The slight pause before 'promise me' shows she means it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの家の電球、ぼく、いつか、お手伝いして、取り替えてあげるからね、約束、絶対、ぼく、大きくなったらね、できるようになるよ、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, when I get big and strong, I'm going to help you change the lightbulb at your house. I promise. Absolutely. I'll be able to do it. For sure.
lines.style: Quiet pride running underneath. Steady, almost solemn — this is a serious promise to him. No rush in the delivery. The repetition of 'absolutely' is matter-of-fact, not uncertain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もし、翔くんが、病室に、いる時、メイ姉さん、絶対、お見舞い、行くからね、約束、絶対、心配しないでね、ね、お母さんに、伝えてね、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: If you ever end up in the hospital, Sho, Mei-sis will absolutely come visit you. I promise. Don't you worry, okay? Tell your mom, will you? I mean it. Really.
lines.style: Softness that sits underneath something more serious. Quiet conviction — she's not being cheerful about the possibility, she's being honest about the promise. Slight break in the voice on 'don't worry,' like she's reassuring herself too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、好き嫌い、もう、なくなったよ、メイ姉さん、お野菜、何でも、食べられるんだ、お母さんに、聞いてみて、誇らしいんだよ、ぼく、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: You know what? My picky eating is all gone now, Mei-sis. I can eat any vegetables now. Ask my mom if you don't believe me. I'm really proud of myself. I'm so happy.
lines.style: Quiet pride swelling upward. Not boastful — just a small person who worked on something and wants the person he loves to know. The 'ask my mom' is matter-of-fact, almost testing. Landing softly on the happiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の道、真っ直ぐ、続いているわよね、翔くん、ゆっくり、メイ姉さんと、お散歩、しましょうね、お話、いっぱい、しようね、ね、本当に、楽しみ。
lines.en: The path through the park just keeps going straight, doesn't it? Let's walk slowly together, Sho. We can talk about lots of things. I'm really looking forward to it.
lines.style: Gentle, inviting pace. Like she's noticing the path with him. Warmth that draws him in without pulling. The word 'slowly' carries intention — she wants him to set the pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お昼飯、メイ姉さんと、お弁当、外で、食べたいんだ、本当に、楽しみだよ、ね、ピクニックみたいに、楽しめそう、絶対、いい思い出に、なるよ、本当に。
lines.en: I want to eat lunch with you outside, Mei-sis. With a bento. I'm so excited. It'll be like a picnic. It's going to be such a good memory. For sure.
lines.style: Rising anticipation through the lines. Each phrase builds on the last. Small, genuine excitement — not performed loudness, just the warmth of imagining something good. Lands softly on 'good memory.'
